messages:
Aisha Patel (CS): Quick kickoff for Coppersky onboarding — putting stakeholders, draft success criteria, timeline, and known risks in one thread. Start: Mon Feb 5. Ask: please confirm owners for week1/week2 and any missing stakeholders. High-level goals: 1) Private deployment in test VPC, 2) one integration with their tagging pipeline, 3) baseline latency & cost. Risks: data path review + infra quotas.
Ben Liu (Solutions Eng): Ack — I'll own SE work: connector prototype + sample prompts. Target: EOD Tue for first demo artifacts.
Devon Park (PM): Can we sketch a 30/60/90 milestones list here? Also Claire — who else should be on invites (security, infra, analytics)?
Claire Zhang (Coppersky): Thanks — will invite Security (Sam Moreno), Infra Ops (Marta Ruiz) and Analytics (Leo Tan). Week of Feb 5 works.
Jules Rivera (Eng): I'll take infra prep (VPC, routing, smoke tests). Need VPC CIDR & acceptance test criteria. Quick terraform snippet I'll use: ```terraform apply -var 'vpc_cidr=10.52.0.0/16'```
Aisha Patel (CS): Draft success metrics added: P95 generation latency < 250ms at 512 tokens; embeddings baseline >= 100 QPS; end-to-end integration demo by day 14; handoff docs complete by day 14. Note: flag renewal risk if integration not validated by day 30.
Ben Liu (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the runbook and upload to /cs/coppersky repo. Any security gating we should know about now, Claire?
Claire Zhang (Coppersky): Yes — retention 90 days, KMS-managed keys required, and audit logging to Splunk. I'll DM the KMS ARN to Aisha.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: Kickoff meeting Feb 5 10:00 PST. Invite sent to listed stakeholders.
Devon Park (PM): Can we add a 30m pre-demo rehearsal on Feb 12 for execs? Aim: Aisha + Ben + Jules to present.
Aisha Patel (CS): Added rehearsal. Owners: Week1 owner = Ben Liu; Week2 owner = Jules Rivera; Success sign-off = Claire Zhang + Devon Park. I'll update Trello board and post link here when done.
Ben Liu (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup:
Jules Rivera (Eng): Will post infra smoke-test results by Friday. FYI submitted quota increase for GPUs (ticket #2345).
Claire Zhang (Coppersky): One more ask — please add a short tech checklist: auth flow, API key rotation plan, audit log retention and sample query for compliance.
Aisha Patel (CS): Will add those to the checklist and ping once updated. Thanks all — small PRs welcome on the onboarding doc if you see missing bits.
